H_GATE: # Engine rulings (ruled before this turn; write by them; do not re-roll or repeat the request)
mention_town: - {name}: in {where} ({chain}); nobody knows where in town exactly — he has to be asked after or walked to; don't make him appear out of nowhere
mention_place: - {name}: in {where}{chain}; the player has to get there first to see him
switched: Switched to the {title} layer: go on writing this round from this line
ungrounded: this did not happen in the prose (Jev grounded check)
missing_line: {name}'s line is missing from the prose (she said: "{line}"). Work it into the prose once, word for word, not paraphrased; do not write her action as its opposite
one_round_per_beat: This beat has already had its round ({op}); the reply above is that round. Don't call it again: finish the beat from that reply and stop; the next round is the next beat's.
hit_no_hp: {n} check(s) passed (hits), yet the ops have no hp change: a hit must be followed by a damage roll [dice 1d6+mod]…[/dice], then foe.<id>.hp -N or player.hp -N; a wound only in the prose and not in the ops never happened
require_tool: This round has no [{need} …] request: the result is not yours to decide — write the request first and the result after the engine answers; or write {exit} to end it
clamped_move: This turn only reaches {to}: {why}. Change the prose to stop at {to}; do not write that {wanted} was reached; keep move_to {wanted}
ruled_tool: - agreed payment (the engine already settled it and it is in the state; do not write this variable again): {var} {delta:+}
beat_timeout: (This beat ran out of time; the world holds here for now. Try saying it again.)
refit: # What was sent back from the last state transition (change only these; the prose stays)
split_narrate:
## This time: prose only
Ignore the output format above: output only the prose itself — no JSON, no state block.
split_extract: You are a state extractor. You are given the world's entries, variables and a piece of prose that just happened. Output only one JSON object {"ops": [ … ]}; the ops' shape and rules are as below. Nothing that did not happen in the prose; every move / spending / injury / time / new place that did happen must be there.
par_ops: You are a state settler. You are given the world's entries, variables, the characters' replies and the player's line. Output only one JSON object {"ops": [ … ]} with the state changes that **certainly happen** this turn (moves the player declares, where the replies say characters go, spending / injury / time passing / new places stated outright); nothing that may or may not happen. The ops' shape and rules are as below.
split2_narrate:
## This time: prose only
Output only the prose itself (plain text) — no JSON, no state block, no options.
split2_extract:
# The prose that just happened (final; do not change it)
{narr}

## Now output only the state
Output only one JSON object {{"ops": [ … ]}}: every move / spending / injury / time passing / new place / where a character went that happened in the prose must be there; nothing that did not happen; with no change, {{"ops": []}}.
